findings.description: X-Powered-By header discloses underlying backend technology and versions.
Server header reveals web server software and banner information.

Retire.js detected vulnerable/outdated client-side library 'jquery-validation' (version 1.19.5). ReDoS vulnerability in URL2 validation regex. Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability via showLabel — error messages are injected into the DOM without sanitization. Remediation: Upgrade to jquery-validation 1.20.0 or newer.
findings.evidence:
Component: jquery-validation v1.19.5
Detected via: File Content (Banner)
Identified in: /CourierSolution/lib/jquery-validation/dist/jquery.validate.js
Known CVEs: CVE-2022-31147, CVE-2025-3573
Recommended: Upgrade to jquery-validation 1.20.0 or newer.
